gd-portable-json-v1.scope: new snapshot inventories and archive envelopes only
gd-portable-json-v1.stringSerialization: JSON strings without optional escaping, invalid Unicode rejected
gd-portable-json-v1.numbers: integer lexical form only, -9007199254740991 through 9007199254740991; reject -0, decimal and exponent lexemes before parsing
gd-portable-json-v1.duplicateKeys: reject decoded duplicates before map construction
gd-portable-json-v1.note: Restricted JCS-compatible domain, not an implementation of arbitrary RFC 8785 numbers.

gd-deterministic-json-v1.scope: historical pack and manifest canonical-json digests
gd-deterministic-json-v1.unicodeNormalization: NFC on decoded keys and strings
gd-deterministic-json-v1.keyCollision: reference verifier rejects collisions rather than reproducing data loss
gd-deterministic-json-v1.verifiedNumericDomain: safe integers in this corpus; other historical numeric domains are not inferred

deterministic-json-sort-keys-v0.scope: historical selected JSON units and complete JSON artifacts
deterministic-json-sort-keys-v0.verifiedNumericDomain: safe integers and finite non-integral decimals with magnitude at least 0.0001 and less than 10000000000000000; reject other numeric cases as unsupported

utf8-nfc-lf-trimmed-v0.scope: historical selected text and complete text artifacts

attested-interpretive-unit-envelope-v0.excluded: All fields not listed; notably allowedTransformations and forbiddenTransformations are not covered by the historical unit digest. The new snapshot covers their complete registry bytes separately.

selector.grammar: $ or $.property followed by zero or more .property, each property optionally followed by one non-negative array index
selector.cardinality: exactly one value; duplicate decoded JSON keys are invalid

snapshotRoot.preimage: gd-portable-json-v1 of snapshot.inventory, all and only its fields
